2025 Responses to key sponsor enquiries &#8226; Accelerated approval- May be appropriate for this indication. &#8226; Primary &amp; key endpoints- FDA stated that there are insufficient data to use CTCs as a surrogate endpoint but provided feedback
on additional steps to support validation of CTCs to support future applications. Agency encouraged study of patient reported outcomes, neurologic function as well as overall survival as potential basis of marketing approval. Agency &amp; Sponsor
aligned that CTCs could be considered for use as a key secondary endpoint. &#8226; Trial design &amp; comparator group- Agency &amp; Sponsor aligned on a randomized controlled design approach. Agency &amp; sponsor further discussed that the study
may include an intrathecal chemotherapeutic as a comparator and approaches to standardize the available comparator chemotherapy regimens as well as any background and rescue interventions under the trial protocol in both active and control arms.
&#8226; Treated populations- Agency conveyed that it may be reasonable to incorporate multiple histologies in a single trial, i.e. multiple underlying etiologies in LM. 29 Plus Therapeutics, Inc. NASDAQ: PSTV</font></p>
